name: annual_budget_planning_triage
description: State and action template for annual budget planning application ticket triage.

new.description: Ticket has arrived but has not been analyzed.

extracting_context.description: Normalize the ticket and collect title, description, comments, links, and attachments.

missing_info.description: The ticket is blocked because required rulebook context is missing.

checking_known_behavior.description: Check whether the ticket matches documented intended behavior.

routing_review.description: Context is valid and the ticket needs an owner route.

ready_for_access_review.description: Access request has enough fields to begin access review.

routed_finance.description: Ticket is routed to finance for policy, accrual, currency, FX, or SAP financial-record review.

routed_crc_l3.description: Ticket is routed to CRC/L3 for integration, pipeline, sync, or complex application logic.

routed_data_quality.description: Ticket is routed to data quality stewardship for direct remediation or configuration cleanup.

waiting_reporter_confirmation.description: A fix or explanation was sent and the system is waiting for reporter confirmation.

complete.description: Work is functionally complete and can be closed.

human_review.description: A human agent reviews and decides whether to apply the recommendation.

transitions.description: Begin extracting rulebook fields from the ticket.
Data quality tickets require at least one PO number, project/S-code, document link, or screenshot.
Known batch sync lag should be explained rather than routed.
Finance policy, accrual, currency, FX, or SAP financial-record issues route to finance.
Sync, pipeline, integration, crash, or complex logic issues route to CRC/L3.
Direct data remediation, merge, void, or configuration issues route to data quality.

access_request.description: User asks for app access, role changes, or permission changes.

required_fields.label: Name
required_fields.prompt: Please provide the user's full name.

required_fields.label: LDAP
required_fields.prompt: Please provide the user's LDAP.

required_fields.label: Portfolio
required_fields.prompt: Please provide the relevant portfolio.

required_fields.label: Region
required_fields.prompt: Please provide the user's region.

required_fields.label: User role
required_fields.prompt: Please provide the requested in-app role.

required_fields.label: Project type
required_fields.prompt: Please provide the project type, such as active or pre-planning.

required_fields.label: Leads
required_fields.prompt: Please provide the relevant lead or approver.

required_fields.label: Additional context
required_fields.prompt: Please provide any additional context needed to grant the appropriate in-app role.

routing_hint.reason: Access and role-change requests should be reviewed by app access administrators.

access_request.clarification_style: Ask for the missing access request fields in a concise checklist.

application_issue.description: User reports something broken, incorrect, slow, unavailable, or confusing in the app.

required_fields.label: Portfolio
required_fields.prompt: Please provide the portfolio.

required_fields.label: Region
required_fields.prompt: Please provide the region.

required_fields.label: Site
required_fields.prompt: Please provide the site.

required_fields.label: Project code
required_fields.prompt: Please provide the project code.

required_fields.label: Project name
required_fields.prompt: Please provide the project name.

required_fields.label: Detailed issue description
required_fields.prompt: Please describe what happened, what you expected, and any specific error or incorrect value.

routing_hint.reason: Application issues should be triaged by the application support team.

application_issue.clarification_style: Ask for the missing app context needed to reproduce or investigate the issue.

feature_request.description: User asks for new app functionality or an enhancement.

required_fields.label: Requested capability
required_fields.prompt: Please describe the new capability or enhancement requested.

required_fields.label: Business reason
required_fields.prompt: Please explain the business reason or workflow impact.

required_fields.label: Urgency
required_fields.prompt: Please provide the urgency or target timeline.

routing_hint.reason: Feature requests should be reviewed by the product owner before engineering sizing.

feature_request.clarification_style: Ask for product impact and urgency rather than implementation details.

intended_behavior.description: User reports an issue, but triage determines the app is working as designed.

routing_hint.reason: Support should explain expected behavior and link documentation when available.

intended_behavior.clarification_style: Explain the observed behavior and ask whether the user wants a feature request opened.

duplicate.description: Ticket appears to match an existing known ticket.

routing_hint.reason: Potential duplicate closure requires human confirmation.

duplicate.clarification_style: Summarize the matching ticket and request human confirmation.

other_or_unknown.description: Insufficient information or outside the current taxonomy.

required_fields.label: Ticket details
required_fields.prompt: Please provide more detail about what you need or what issue you are seeing.

routing_hint.reason: Unknown tickets should start with support triage.

other_or_unknown.clarification_style: Ask a short open clarification question.

report_performance_issue.description: Unable to view or download reports, slow reports, report timeouts, or broken report links.

required_fields.label: Affected link
required_fields.prompt: Please provide the link where the report issue occurs.

required_fields.label: Screenshot
required_fields.prompt: Please attach a screenshot of the report issue if available.

routing_hint.reason: Report view/download/performance issues usually need reporting platform investigation.

budget_variance_issue.description: Variance analysis, forecast, fiscal period, or currency values appear incorrect.

required_fields.label: Project currency
required_fields.prompt: Please provide the project currency.

routing_hint.reason: Budget variance issues need application and finance-data review.

data_quality_issue.description: Missing, stale, or inconsistent data in the app.

routing_hint.reason: Data quality issues need source-data validation.

ui_workflow_issue.description: A page, button, filter, or workflow does not behave as expected.

routing_hint.reason: UI workflow issues begin with support reproduction.

integration_issue.description: Upstream or downstream sync, import, export, or API issue.

routing_hint.reason: Integration issues require sync or API investigation.
